faq.a: Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's annual summer fair, held in June. In 2037, it runs from June 4 to June 10. The fair features live music, traditional flamenco, casetas (tents), rides, and local food and drink. It takes place at the fairground near the centre of Marbella, just a short drive from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: How do I get from the fair to the boat?
faq.a: The fairground is about 5 km from Puerto Banús, a 10-minute taxi ride. Most boat charters depart from Puerto Banús marina. We recommend booking a taxi or private transfer in advance during Feria week, as demand is high. Some guests combine a daytime boat trip with an evening at the fair.

faq.q: What boats are available for a Feria boat party?
faq.a: We offer a range of boats from Puerto Banús. For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are ideal. For larger parties, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) start at €749/2h. The Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski from €4,719/4h.

faq.q: What is included in the charter price?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21% VAT). No hidden costs. You just need to bring your swimwear, sunscreen, and a good mood.

faq.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and additional drinks. The boat already includes complimentary drinks and snacks, but you can supplement with your own favourites. Glass bottles are allowed, but please use plastic cups on deck for safety.

faq.q: What is the best time of day for a boat party during Feria?
faq.a: Afternoon charters (2–6 PM or 4–8 PM) are popular as you can enjoy the sun, swim stops, and return to port in time to freshen up before heading to the fair at night. Morning trips (10 AM–2 PM) offer calmer seas and fewer crowds. Evening trips at sunset are also magical.

faq.q: Is the boat party suitable for families with children?
faq.a: Yes, many of our boats are family-friendly. The skipper will ensure a safe and enjoyable experience. Children are welcome on all charters. Life jackets for all sizes are provided. The Fairline Targa 12m and Lagoon 380 catamaran are particularly good for families due to their spacious decks.

faq.q: How do I book a boat for Feria San Bernabe 2037?
faq.a: You can book directly through our website or via WhatsApp. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), prices are fixed and you can reserve online. For larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80, pricing is on request. We recommend booking at least 2–3 weeks in advance for Feria week.

data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2037 runs from June 4 to June 10, transforming Marbella into a week-long celebration of music, dance, and local culture. For many visitors, the perfect day involves a morning or afternoon feria san bernabe boat party 2037 on the Mediterranean, followed by an evening at the fairground. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, just 10 minutes from the fair, offering private charters from €749/2h with a licensed skipper, drinks, snacks, and all taxes included.

Why choose a boat party during Feria San Bernabe?

Marbella in June averages 28°C sea temperature and 12 hours of sunshine. A boat party lets you escape the fairground crowds, swim at secluded coves like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés, and enjoy the coastline from the water. You control the music, the itinerary, and the guest list. After your trip, you're minutes from the fair by taxi.

Our fleet for Feria boat parties

We offer boats for groups of 5 to 12 guests. All depart from Puerto Banús and include a professional skipper, fuel, drinks (water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava), light snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) are also available. View our full fleet here.

Recommended itinerary for a Feria boat party

A typical 4-hour charter from Puerto Banús heads east towards Cabopino or west towards Estepona. Popular stops include Cala del Faro (a quiet cove with turquoise water) and Cala Cortés. The skipper knows the best anchorages based on wind and swell. Many guests combine a 2-hour trip with a swim stop, then return to port for lunch before the fair.

What to bring and what to expect

We provide all drinks and snacks. Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (SPF 50+ recommended), sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket for evening trips. Music is via Bluetooth – bring your playlist. Glass bottles are allowed but use plastic cups on deck. The skipper will give a safety briefing at departure.

Booking tips for Feria week

Feria San Bernabe is one of Marbella's busiest weeks. Boats book out quickly. We recommend reserving at least 2–3 weeks in advance. For Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39), you can book online at fixed prices. For larger yachts, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote. Start your booking here.
